# TransitionNote

The thin strip between two running-order rows that says how the move lands: energy step, key move, BPM delta and genre switch, each with a verdict glyph.

`SongNodes.TransitionNote` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.TransitionNote items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.TransitionNote" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (TransitionNoteProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `TransitionNoteItem[]` | One item per dimension that changes between the two slots. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | Expanded form with reasons (slot detail, hover card). |

### TransitionNoteItem

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `"energy" \| "key" \| "bpm" \| "genre"` | What changes: "energy", "key", "bpm" or "genre". |
| `level` * | `"perfect" \| "compatible" \| "possible" \| "clash" \| "unknown" \| "neutral"` | Verdict colour and glyph. |
| `label` * | `string` | Short label ("+1 key 8A→9A", "+2 BPM", "House → UK garage"). |
| `why` | `string` | One-sentence reason, shown in the expanded form and the tooltip. |
